name: perfmonctl
synopsis: long perfmonctl(int fd, int cmd, void *arg[.narg], int narg);
description: The perfmonctl system call provides an interface to the IA-64 performance monitoring unit (PMU), which includes registers for gathering hardware statistics. It performs operations specified by a command on the provided arguments, operating on a perfmon context identified by a file descriptor.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the perfmon context to operate on

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Command to execute, such as PFM_CREATE_CONTEXT or PFM_START

parameters.name: narg
parameters.description: Number of arguments in the arg array

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

bugs: This system call was broken for many years and was removed in Linux 5.10.
versions: Added in Linux 2.4; removed in Linux 5.10
